 One tank of air, one speargun, and a very deep hole in the sea floor.

Reef Dive is a 3D underwater action game. Spear fish for coins, recover lost relics from the deep, and get back to the boat before your air runs out. Blood in the water draws sharks: dash clear, or fight them off.


Two ways to dive: swim as a scuba diver with a spear, or pilot a research submarine with sonar and a tractor beam.

A living reef: thousands of schooling fish, sharks, orcas, manta rays, sea turtles and blue whales.

Four depth zones, from the sunlit coral shelf down through the glowing twilight to the abyss floor 140 m below.

Upgrade your tank, suit, fins, spear and sub between dives, take on contracts, and find all 12 lost relics.

Seven dive kits to wear, a photo mode with filters, and a Free Dive mode with endless air.


Plays in your browser with keyboard and mouse, or touch. Your progress is saved to your Wavedash account.
